title: Platform Blueprint
description: Schema for platforms/<platform>/blueprint.yaml. Declares which core/ components a platform uses. Whether a component is used as-is from core/ or overridden is not declared here - it is decided at build/assembly time purely by file presence: if platforms/<platform>/<type>/<name>.md exists, it takes precedence over the core/ version of the same name (see ARCHITECTURE.md Override logic). This keeps the blueprint from drifting out of sync with the actual override files on disk.

platform.description: Platform identifier this blueprint configures (e.g. claude, chatgpt). Must match the platforms/<platform>/ folder name.

version.description: Semantic version of this blueprint file, as a quoted string (e.g. "1.0").

components.description: Components this platform uses, grouped by type. Each entry is the component's `name` front matter value, not a file path.

outputs.description: Optional. Merges components into shared artifact files, for platforms whose slots don't match the default one-file-per-component layout (e.g. a platform with no separate skill slot, or one that needs the same component repeated across several files). Keys are arbitrary target artifact names (e.g. general-instructions, skills, my-project-instructions). Values are lists of `type:name` references, where `type` is one of personas/skills/shared-blocks/output-templates and `name` must already be declared under the matching list in `components`. A component referenced here is merged into every listed output file instead of getting its own default file; the same reference may appear under multiple output keys (duplication is allowed, not an error) if it needs to be repeated. Any component NOT referenced anywhere in `outputs` keeps the default behavior: its own file named after it. `outputs` never contains literal prompt text - only references to components defined in core/source/ or platforms/<platform>/.

componentNameList.description: Names of components of this type used by the platform. Default resolution at assembly time (when NOT referenced in `outputs`): each component gets its own file, using platforms/<platform>/<type>/<name>.md if it exists, otherwise core/source/<type>/<name>.md.
